payload.gap_claim: The gap i4 closes is INTERNAL and precisely measured by the drained inbox: the system i3 shipped works but still sheds (a) human readability on its own board, (b) completeness of its own laws (requirements with tests but missing refusals or loop wiring), and (c) trust hygiene (unswept stamps, unschema'd mints, an unaudited early bless). No external alternative applies - the field is our own record: 13 pulled notes, 6 pains, 4 register gaps, all pointing at the same seam between what is drawn/required and what is enforced/rendered.
payload.why_now: Three things matured yesterday and today: the executor and lanes exist (so completing them is wiring, not architecture), the record lanes measure everything (so every gap has a number and a witness), and the owner's retro rulings resolved the open design questions (scorer = research agent, build_steps drawn, scope B). The completion cost is at its lifetime minimum right now, while the i3 context is hot.

Need: the board reads human | outcome: JSON as a collapsible tree, parallel branches side-by-side, maximize truly maximizes, scroll survives refresh; PASS: the owner walks one gate detail end-to-end without raw JSON, and one parallel span renders as two columns on the live board. Need: nothing pending on trust | outcome: i1 bless re-adjudicated, the 7 stamps corrected, trace-dir ruled; PASS: zero pending-owner markers queryable in the ledger. One-pager B - the machine itself. Need: laws complete | outcome: test-lane refusal, schema refusals, loop-level parallel serving, child engine-states and gates, inherit acceptance; PASS: one iteration walks M1 with log_risks and pressure_test SERVED (never inline), and a child machine runs an engine-filled chunk. Need: quality visible absolutely | outcome: research-agent scores against anchors on the evaluate states; PASS: the next architecture gate carries a 0-5 row beside the Pugh result. One-pager C - the future reader. Need: the record navigable | outcome: glossary drafts, structure-talk ruling, link-rename ripple; PASS: 139 glossary stubs exist and one rename updates every inbound link in a single apply.
payload.business_case: No acquirer - recorded reason stands from i3: the currency is the owner's working day, and i4 buys back the friction the owner personally named this morning.
